author: michalzx
title: fusings_gpu pooling_f32_scale fp16_scale_out fails GPU unit test tolerance check
signature: gpu unit tests fusion pooling scale fp16 difference between val ref and val opt exceeds tolerance|Flaky Test

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: fusings_gpu/pooling_f32_scale.fp16_scale_out/1 fails a numeric tolerance assertion by a single fp16 ULP

key_errors:
C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\openvino\src\plugins\intel_gpu\tests\unit\fusions\fusion_test_common.hpp(90): error: The difference between val_ref[i] and val_opt[i] is 3.0517578125e-05, which exceeds tolerance, where
val_ref[i] evaluates to -0.04473876953125,
val_opt[i] evaluates to -0.044769287109375, and
tolerance evaluates to 9.9999997473787516e-06.
i = 14
root_cause: A single fp16 element (index 14) of the fused pooling+scale GPU kernel output differs from the unfused reference by 3.0517578125e-05 (exactly one fp16 ULP at that magnitude), while the test's tolerance is fixed at 1e-5 regardless of value scale. This is the same signature already recorded in pattern 7b64fedfacbfda60 from run 43417057783 (PR #38855), confirming it recurs intermittently across unrelated merge-queue runs rather than being caused by this PR's (docs-only) change.
reproduction_steps: Run `ov_gpu_unit_tests.exe --gtest_filter=fusings_gpu/pooling_f32_scale.fp16_scale_out/1` repeatedly on a Windows GPU runner; the comparison is borderline and fails intermittently depending on GPU driver/kernel scheduling nondeterminism.
recommended_actions: Widen the fp16 comparison tolerance in fusion_test_common.hpp for scale-fused pooling tests, or compare in relative terms for small magnitudes
Investigate whether the fused kernel path introduces a deterministic extra rounding step versus the unfused reference path for this test case
Track recurrence via pattern 7b64fedfacbfda60; escalate to the GPU plugin owners if it exceeds 3 occurrences in 12 hours
prevention_strategies: Use relative/ULP-aware tolerance comparisons for fp16 fused-vs-unfused kernel validation instead of a single fixed absolute epsilon, since fp16 ULP size grows with magnitude.
historical_context: Identical signature previously recorded 2026-11-13T23:41:12Z in run https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino/actions/runs/43417057783 (PR #38855). A rerun-pattern proposal for this exact signature is already open as PR #39838 (not yet merged); this run should not generate a duplicate proposal.
